audit.whatIsWrong: Full layer reads Naafiri/Naafiri/Naafiri/Naafiri/Skill/Skill/Naafiri while content win[] and the packet chart read Karma/Karma/Karma/Karma/Naafiri/Naafiri/Karma. Every row disagrees across layers.
audit.why: Karma's 950-range Q and 675 tether beat a 450-range Eviscerate and a 900 Darkin Daggers before Naafiri has R, so levels 1-5 are Karma's. Hounds' Pursuit at 6 (110s, lock-on dash, recast with shield) hands 6 and first item to Naafiri. At 45.52% over 145 games Karma does not own the late game either, and Naafiri's 80s R picks a champion with no dash, so row 6 belongs to Naafiri on both layers.
audit.corrected: phases[0..3].side to Karma, phases[4..5].side to Naafiri, phases[6] stays Naafiri and content win[6] flips Karma to Naafiri with whys[6], late and spikes[3] rewritten to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns holds no digit and no Naafiri ability is named anywhere in the matchup. Nothing mentions that The Call of the Pack (W) and Hounds' Pursuit (R) both grant untargetability, or that Eviscerate (E) fully heals her packmates.
audit.why: Untargetable frames decide whether your RQ-W commit lands or is thrown away, and the E heal is why extended trades need Grievous Wounds.

notes: Chart proposed as one atomic group. Rows 0-5 were fixed by moving the full layer onto the content/packet values (win[0..5] already hold the target strings, so no paired content edit is proposable there — an edit would fail the exact-before check). Row 6 was the reverse: full already said Naafiri, so win[6] moves instead, with whys[6], late and spikes[3] rewritten in the same proposal. Confidence Medium on row 6 specifically: I inferred it from the 45.52% win rate over 145 games plus Naafiri's 80s lock-on R against a dashless Karma, not from a wiki source. Ratings left untouched throughout — I could not determine from the data whether phases[N].rating is owner-favourability or matchup severity, and did not want to guess on an enum a reader trusts.
